caption: the last week of 2026 in the sky: a test, a clean-up, then two trines on new year's eve. dec 28 – jan 3.

slides.headline: the last week of *2026* ends on a good note
the *sun* squares saturn: the boring true thing
slides.body: reads as limits and responsibility. say what you can actually give.

slides.headline: last quarter *moon* in libra: clear the table
slides.body: half-lit and shrinking. a good day to end what is already over.

slides.headline: *mercury* squares saturn: the hard conversation
slides.body: short, honest, done. do not drag it into next year.

slides.headline: the *sun* and mercury both trine mars on new year's eve
slides.body: energy and words line up. the midnight kiss can come with a sentence.

slides.headline: the *sun* meets mercury in capricorn on day one
slides.body: a clear head to start 2027. write down what you want.

slides.headline: the one to watch: *new year's eve*. say it before midnight
slides.body: then the first new moon of 2027 is jan 7, in capricorn.
